question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is: **captivity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"captivity"** means the condition of being imprisoned or confined. (कैद)

 
 
• **Example: **The animals were kept in captivity for several years before being released back into the wild.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that in confinement lions can reach the age of twenty-five.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word in the context is **'captivity'** because it fits the meaning of being confined or imprisoned.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. captivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disaster **(आपदा): A sudden event that causes great damage or loss.

 
 
• **Example:** The flood was a disaster that affected thousands of people.
 
 
 
• **Banality **(साधारणता ): The condition of being unoriginal or dull.
 
 
• **Example: **The banality of the speech made it very boring for the audience.
 
 
 
• **Greenery** (हरियाली): Lush green vegetation.
 
 
• **Example:** The park is full of lush greenery and beautiful flowers.
